rationale: No safe floor was found on the sealed development set. Under the no-hit@5-regression and at-most-5%-relevant-empty constraints, the best candidate floor (0.871314914598602) rejected only 55% of absent queries and 62.5% of off-domain anchors, below the required 60% and 100%. The expected-source and absent top-score distributions overlap, so applying a numeric floor would either retain too much noise or sacrifice known-answer behavior.
